title: Enterprise data-control requests operator runbook and prioritization lattice
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Purpose: Create an operator-focused runbook and prioritization lattice that productizes how we intake, score, and route enterprise requests about data governance controls (logging/redaction, retention, PII handling, audit exports). This ticket captures an actionable checklist, scoring rubric, routing rules, expected SLA for responses, handoff artifacts for Eng/Security/Legal, and example email templates.

Scope: non-bug customer requests that ask for changes/enhancements to data handling and auditability. Examples: custom log redaction rules, customer-specific retention windows, PII handling guidance for embeddings, scheduled audit exports, or requests to add a control to the Console UI. Not in scope: endpoint outages, infra incidents, or model behavior change requests (these get routed to support/eng incident channels).

Outcome: A single, operator-readable JSON+Markdown artifact in Confluence (linked below) and a set of Linear tags + automation rules that route requests to the right triage bucket and produce an intake packet for Eng, Security, and Legal reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page runbook describing intake steps, scoring rubric, routing rules, and SLA targets is published and linked from the internal Support->PM playbook.
A prioritization lattice (scorecard) that scores requests on: data sensitivity, regulatory exposure, customer size/ARR, engineering effort, and concurrency risk is defined and documented.
Automation: Incoming requests tagged 'data-control' trigger a templated intake email to the PM on-call and create a triage item with the scorecard pre-filled.
Handoff: Every routed request must include a standard artifact set: customer description, example logs/data, retention requirement, business justification, and contact for legal/compliance checks.

SLA: Initial response time (acknowledge & assign) within 3 business days for P2/P1 and 1 business day for P0/high-risk; estimated delivery window or roadmap placement communicated within 10 business days for approved requests.
Security signoff gating: any changes that affect storage/encryption/PII handling require Security and Legal signoff before engineering spec work begins.
triage_scorecard: Score categories (0-5 each): data sensitivity (PII/PHI=5), regulatory risk (GDPR/CCPA/FINRA=5), customer criticality (enterprise SLA=5), engineering effort (1=low - 5=very high), cross-customer impact (1=single-tenant - 5=platform-wide)

Weighted formula: total = 0.35*sensitivity + 0.25*regulatory + 0.20*customer_criticality + 0.10*engineering_effort + 0.10*cross_customer; translate to priority bands: 4.0+ = P0, 3.0-3.99 = P1, 2.0-2.99 = P2, <2.0 = P3.
Quick rules: any item scoring sensitivity>=4 AND regulatory>=3 is automatically escalated to Security for immediate review (flag: escalated-security).
Retention requests: if requested retention < our minimum platform retention, mark 'requires infra change' and add dependency on dedicated-retention-policy subproject.

2026-03-04: Finalized score weighting to favor data sensitivity and regulatory risk after stakeholder feedback.
